description: Finalize a previously uploaded Preview PNG — a closed two-branch union. READY (default, requires checksumSha256 + byteSize): the server verifies session binding, PNG signature, byte size, checksum, and render revision before CAS-marking the artifact READY. FAILED (requires failureCode, optional bounded failureDetail; omit checksum/byteSize): durably records a typed capture failure so no artifact stays silently pending; re-arm happens only through a same-key prepare retry. Replays converge only on an identical outcome (409 FAILURE_MISMATCH / ALREADY_READY / FINALIZE_CONFLICT otherwise). Requires lms:write.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable idempotency key. Reuse only for the identical operation.

name: opentrain_lms_finalize_preview_artifact
